This '''battle''' was fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The result was a victory for the Alliance, who managed to take the strongpoint, securing prisoners and equipment before retreating.<ref name="Whiskers" />
